<!-- Title rule: same form as a commit title — type(scope): summary, e.g.
     `docs(audio-core): record the limiter defaults`. Never title an issue
     with its plan slice; the plan index already tracks that. -->

## Problem

<!-- What is broken or missing, from the user's perspective. One item per issue. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- What must be true before the plan checkbox may be ticked. -->

## Repro

<!-- For bugs only: steps, backend (desktop/web) and version, expected, actual,
     and the smallest AudioConfigBuilder chain or Play sequence that triggers it.
     Delete this section for features. -->

## Reopening condition

<!-- Only if the idea is parked: the concrete condition that brings it back.
     Also record it in design/deferred.md and close this issue with a pointer
     to that entry. Delete this section otherwise. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Reviewers and agents: append verdicts, commit links, listening results,
     and revert notes as comments here. Never post status — the plan checkbox
     is the truth, and issues stay an inbox. -->
